title: KIST Connects South Korean Quantum Startups to Midwest Ecosystem Across Wisconsin and Chicago - Quantum Computing Report
gist: KIST’s Global Bridge Program took four South Korean quantum startups (TruPixel, OptiQ-Labs, QRENS, Elixir) through Wisconsin and Chicago after Quantum World Congress 2026 to seek US partnerships, under Korea’s DIPS deeptech incubator project.

insights.claim: Four South Korean quantum startups expanded US commercial strategy via KIST’s Global Bridge Program across Wisconsin and Illinois following Quantum World Congress 2026.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Korean quantum firms are seeking US market entry and partners, which may lead to US-Korea tie-ups or listings.

insights.claim: The initiative is part of Korea’s Deeptech Incubator Project for Startups (DIPS), overseen by the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and administered by KIED, with KIST directing the quantum domain.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: State-backed outbound programs signal government priority on quantum startup internationalization.

insights.claim: In Milwaukee the delegation pitched to gener8tor and met the Wisconsin Economic Development Corporation to prepare an official Wisconsin trade delegation visit to South Korea.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Midwest states are courting Korean quantum capital and companies.

insights.claim: In Chicago the delegation met the Chicago Quantum Exchange, Bloch Quantum Tech Hub, mHUB and the 128-acre Illinois Quantum and Microelectronics Park, and presented to CQE founding director David Awschalom while exploring regional microelectronics packaging infrastructure.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Illinois is pitching IQMP’s manufacturing infrastructure to foreign quantum firms.

insights.claim: TruPixel works on SPAD sensors for quantum key distribution, quantum sensing and high-precision imaging; OptiQ-Labs builds ultra-narrow-linewidth lasers and ion-trap hardware.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Component-level quantum photonics suppliers from Korea; relevant to supply-chain mapping.

insights.claim: QRENS offers the QubitSquare AI framework and Q-Vista simulator for digital-twin simulation and circuit optimization, and Elixir offers a hybrid quantum-classical platform for genomic analytics, biomarker discovery and drug-candidate optimization.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Software and application-layer startups; early stage, no financial data given.
